notes.zh-CN:
- 新增 Dlssg_for_sm86 0.4.1 三角洲 / Vulkan 方案，保留旧 0.3.5 和标准 0.4.1；改善桥接资源复用、释放与预算管理。
- 升级 MFG Unlocker 1.7.1，补齐 NR 外观与人物参数、诊断日志开关及新版参数分享。
- 已有 OptiScaler 10 的插件安装可同步配套主 DLL，保留原名称、备份与卸载恢复；普通独立 DLL 安装方式不变。
- Linux AppImage 增加应用内更新、完整性校验、重启确认和启动失败回滚；旧 Linux 用户首次需手动下载本版。
- 保持现有 Windows 界面、渲染与自动更新流程。双平台安装包分别发布。
notes.en:
- Add the Dlssg_for_sm86 0.4.1 Delta Force / Vulkan option while retaining custom 0.3.5 and standard 0.4.1. Improve bridge resource reuse, retirement and memory-budget handling.
- Update MFG Unlocker to 1.7.1 with NR appearance and character settings, local diagnostic logging and compatible preset sharing.
- Plugin installation into an existing OptiScaler 10 setup can update its paired host DLL while retaining its loading name and restoring the original on uninstall. Standalone proxy installation remains unchanged.
- Add a separate Linux AppImage update channel with integrity checks, startup acknowledgement and rollback after launch failure. Earlier Linux versions require one manual download of this version.
- Preserve the existing Windows UI, renderer and update flow. Windows and Linux packages are published independently.
